core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mahaz corresponds to the Arabic form محاز and is glossed in this record as “Camp, station, gathering place.” The record associates the form with root ح و ز (ḥ-w-z). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mahaz corresponds to the Arabic form محاز (Arabic root ح و ز (ḥ-w-z); مَحَاز (Maḥāz)). Its core sense is camp, station, gathering place. Mahaz is Arabic مَحَاز (Maḥāz) 'camp, station, gathering place', from the root ح و ز (ḥ-w-z). The source gloss 'Camp, Station, Gathering' is consistent. Recorded at medium confidence because the word is primarily a common noun.

persian.name: محاز
